description: List completed todos for a month as they appear in todoglow's receipt view, with their current receipt display title. Use this before set_receipt_titles to see what needs a public title. In the receipt's privacy mode, a todo is shown in the clear ONLY if it has a display title; everything else is masked.

only.description: Filter: 'masked' = no display title yet, 'public' = has one. Default all.

name: list_receipt_todos
title: List Receipt Todos
